## Summary

Zephyr Point Media Ltd (policy CC-1481): theft of a 3D printer and filament stock from a locked van at a shared workshop on Tanner Row. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 6,264 dollars.

## Facts

Zephyr Point Media Ltd reported the loss on 20 April 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss was theft from a locked van at a shared workshop on Tanner Row [notice of loss]. The items are a 3D printer and filament stock [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 22 April 2026, reference CR/2026/4169 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The 3D printer is invoiced at 5,181 dollars and the filament stock at 1,083 dollars [invoice 1], [invoice 2].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at the premises named in the schedule, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft, fire, storm or escape of water [policy].

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply. It removes cover for theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared space unless the equipment was in a locked container or locked room. The workshop is shared [notice of loss], but the items were in a locked container [police report], [policy].

Exclusion 7.5 does not apply on the file as it stands. It removes cover where theft is alleged and the loss was not reported to the police within seven days [policy]. The police report is dated 22 April 2026, two days after the notice of loss dated 20 April 2026 [police report], [notice of loss].

Exclusion 7.3 (wear and tear) does not apply: the loss is theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].

Two points are not stated in the file and should be confirmed before payment. The first is the date of the theft, which would confirm the seven-day period under exclusion 7.5 [notice of loss], [police report]. The second is the schedule, which is not in the file. It would confirm the premises or the insured's custody under clause 4.2, and whether it shows an excess [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 6,264 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (5,181 dollars and 1,083 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No schedule showing an excess is in the file, so under clause 9.1 none applies [policy].
